content.introduction: The sources provide specific data on various global market indices as of different dates in 2026. The SENSEX in India closed at 73,895.74 on September 25, 2026, up 0.43%. The NIKKEI 225 in Japan closed at 65,877.62 on September 28, 2026, down 0.73%. The S&P 500 in the USA closed at 7,651.54 on September 30, 2026, down 0.25%. The US Dollar Index closed at 101.65 on October 1, 2026, up 0.19%. The Hang Seng in Hong Kong closed at 24,510.09 on September 25, 2026, down 1.01%. The sources do not provide a definitive answer for some indices on the exact date of October 2, 2026.
